Lumpkin County Public Works will distribute the “Preliminary Inspection Recommendation” sheets to the appropriate County departments. Upon completion of the recommendation sheets, the request will be placed on the agenda for a Board of Commissioners’ work session. At this work session, the BOC will hear recommendations from staff and the applicant and will determine what improvements, if any, need to be completed to the road prior to acceptance into the County Road System. At the next regular meeting of the BOC, the board will vote on whether they will accept the roads at a future date when all required improvements have been made and inspected. The applicant will be required to contact Public Works to schedule inspections prior to any required improvement being made. Upon completion of all required improvements, the applicant will submit the following information to the Public Works Department:

 Four (4) copies of a plat of the area to be deeded to the county meeting the requirements of the Georgia Plat act and the Requirements of the Lumpkin County Code of Ordinances, Chapter 26, Land Development.
 Title opinion acceptable to the Lumpkin County Attorney  A Standard State Bar 50-year Title Standards Certificate and a Right of Way Deed
for the roads to be dedicated acceptable to the Lumpkin County Attorney

Lumpkin County Public Works will distribute the information to the appropriate County departments along with the “Final Acceptance Recommendation” sheets. Once all required information, recommendations and improvements are completed, the request will be placed on the agenda for the BOC meeting. The BOC may then vote to accept the road(s) into the County Road System.
Contact Public Works to schedule inspections of improvements 24 hrs. before the inspection is needed.
Planning/Public Works Department: Larry Reiter, (706) 864-3122

I give m y qualified approval for acceptance of these roads as publicroads. The reasons for my qualified acceptance and all comments and limitations are set out in an addendum to this memorandum.
For reasons set out in detail in the attached addendum, I recommend that the above set out roads NOT be accepted as County Roads.
